# Caltryx: AI Cost Observability & Guardrail Infrastructure

Caltryx is the intelligence layer for AI startups that helps track, optimize, and control LLM costs in real-time.

## Summary
Most AI startups struggle with unpredictable LLM bills. Caltryx provides the monitoring, budget alerts, and guardrail infrastructure needed to build sustainable AI products without compromising on data privacy.

## Features
- **Real-time Cost Observability**: Track spend per agent, per user, or per workflow.
- **Budget Infrastructure**: Set granular budgets and receive alerts before spikes become crises.
- **Privacy-First**: Reporting-only approach that doesn't requires proxying your prompts.
- **Unit Economics**: Gain clear visibility into your gross margins and user-level costs.
